title: The Stories of Sherlock Holmes
paragraphs: A South African Springbok Radio series of original Sherlock Holmes adventures, with Graham Armitage as Holmes and Kerry Jordan as Dr. Watson.
South African Springbok Radio Sherlock Holmes series produced by Michael Silver, starring Graham Armitage as Sherlock Holmes and Kerry Jordan as Dr. Watson.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: Springbok Radio run (1979 to 1985) on [[org|org.e940cdfed3514f24|Springbok Radio]].
Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Graham Armitage (performer) and Kerry Jordan (performer).

The stories often return to Sherlockian deduction and criminal investigation, South African Springbok Radio drama, Sherlock Holmes adaptation and pastiche, Victorian/Edwardian British mystery setting, original Holmes radio mystery, and Irene Adler.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Springbok Radio Sherlock Holmes run, Sherlock Holmes canon and original-radio-story mixture, and Incomplete and uncertain surviving chronology.
